summary: Flat aluminum servo pattern plate on an 8 mm grid. It measures 104 x 40 x 3 mm and has a central 42 x 21 mm servo pocket near one end. The pocket has four tapped mounting holes. The other end has a Ø14 mm bore and several slots, with a grid of Ø4 mm holes between them.

mountingSurfaces.description: Top face of the 3 mm plate; servo seats around the 42 x 21 mm pocket and the hole pattern is accessible.
Bottom face of the 3 mm plate; flat mating face.

notes: Sizes come from the printed drawing: 104 mm length, 40 mm width, 3 mm thickness, 8 mm grid, Ø4 mm holes, Ø14 mm bore, and a 42 x 21 mm pocket. The origin is the plate center, with x along the 104 mm length. The Ø14 mm bore is at the right end. Hole coordinates were scaled from the drawing pixels and snapped to the 8 mm grid, so they are approximate. The pocket center is estimated at about x=-26, y=0. The four tapped holes are at x=-50 and x=-2, y=±5, which gives about 48 mm by 10 mm spacing. They are listed as Ø4 mm and assumed through, which is not confirmed. Vertical slots at x=32, y=±16, horizontal slots near (17,0) and (46,0), short oblong holes near (24,8) and (40,-8), and a small slot at the left end of the pocket are not listed in holes because their exact sizes are not printed. The left-end profile has a rounded bump, and the pocket has corner relief notches. Neither is modeled. Servo spline offset (48 mm) is from the text and not modeled.
